newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers stable, South Korea $1/T higher.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers stable, South Korea $1/T higher.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Wednesday were widely quoted but held largely within Tuesday's range with South Korea seen higher, traders said.
Demand was healthy as some demand has spilled over fom South Korea where prices are about a dollar higher, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst prices in Singapore were quoted at $130 by majors and at $125 by independents, 380-cst at $124 and $119 respectively.
MDO and gasoil were quoted slightly higher at $235 and $250 respectively, up about $3-5 from Tuesday on firm cargo prices.
